<div class="card-body">
'''Exposure''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">凍死</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズにＸフォース消費する。Ｘ＝“夜間状態”の屋外マーカー位置にいるキャラクターの合計人数（その場所にいるものも、行方不明中のものも含む）である。それらのキャラクターは全員ロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Exposure-PSA-154944006.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「アートゥによれば、生き残る確率は725分の１だそうです」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death by freezing.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, use X Force, where X = the total number of characters (whether present or missing) at exterior marker sites under 'nighttime conditions.' All those characters are lost.

'''Lore:'''
"According to Artoo, the chance of survival is 1 in 725."

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says the chance of survival is 1 in 725; the English says 125 to 1.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Exposure]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
